data.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin: Do the Supply Numbers Agree?
data.description: Tom Lee says the gap between Ethereum's and Bitcoin's supply growth is too small to matter, and his firm holds billions in ETH. A closer look at how each coin actually gets created and destroyed shows where his comparison starts to strain.
